title: A pairing request's answer (ship-fleet machine-pair, version 1)
description: What FleetLedger answers a computer it does not know, through the well-known pairing key's forced line (`ship-fleet machine-pair`, while `ship-fleet pair on`; contracts/ship-fleet.md). One document per call, on one line, whatever happens. The command comes from SSH_ORIGINAL_COMMAND alone: `request BLOB NAME` (the computer's own ed25519 public key's base64, and the name it gives itself), `status TOKEN` or `cancel TOKEN`. Nothing here is about the fleet: no Ship, no other machine, no count; an approved request learns only the name it is trusted as, how to reach FleetLedger's own VM, and which refresher to run.

state.description: pending: filed, or still waiting; approved: you approved it (ship-fleet pair approve); refused: you refused it, or the command was not one FleetLedger takes (then why says which); unknown: no request has this token (never filed, withdrawn, or lapsed); busy: as many requests are waiting as FleetLedger takes, try again later; off: pairing by code is off here.

id.description: The request's name on FleetLedger (ship-fleet pair ls): not a secret.

token.description: Random; what status and cancel take. FleetLedger keeps only its SHA-256, and gives it to this caller alone.

nonce.description: Random, chosen by FleetLedger for this request.

code.description: The first 8 hex digits of SHA-256 of `shipshape-pair/1:NONCE:BLOB` (no newline), as a number, modulo 1000000, as six digits. The computer works it out itself from its own key and checks it is this; you type it on FleetLedger to approve.

expires_in.description: Seconds until it lapses unless approved or refused.

oneOf.description: status: approved. The computer then fetches its refresher through its own key (ship-fleet machine-bundle NAME, with this host key pinned) and runs it only when its SHA-256 is refresher_sha256.

machine.description: The name you trusted it as.

host_key.description: FleetLedger's own VM's: the installer goes on only when it is the one it pinned.

oneOf.description: Anything else: refused, unknown, busy or off, with FleetLedger's own fixed words.
